Drilled to total depth, production liner was cemented in place. The well was temporarily suspended. 

BP will return to the well to complete drilling and completions operations prior to the expiration of the 180 day period for lease holding requirements.

Zone abandonment was performed in August 2010.  Additional abandonment operations to plug the well in accordance to 30 CFR 250.1712 through 250.1715 were completed August 10, 2019.  This work satisfies NTL No. 2018-G03 Idle Iron Decommissioning Guidance for Wells and Platforms.  This well only lacks the site clearance to be designated Plugged and Abandoned.  Site clearance will be performed when the platform is removed.

The artifical lift operations to enhance production in the P Sand were completed on 12/28/2009. Please change the completion status of the P Sand to Gas Lift Oil. See attached As-Run Wellbore Schematic for your records.

This was permitted as a TA, but the drilling operation has just been suspended.  It was suspended on 03/27/2008.  I tried to enter that below, however I get an error message.  It will accept 03/23/2008, but this is actually the spud date.

Perforate tubing in the Middle and Upper lobes in AMP 3 sand.  Anadarko was able to shift open the sleeve in the upper zone (instead of perforate tubing) before the platform was shut-in. A revised permit will be filed prior to start of new operations to peforate the tubing in the middle zone.

Upon mobilizaton to the Ship Shoal 198 G Platform and subject G3 well, it was determined that the well had been sidetracked at a previous date.  Further investigation determined that an APM had been submitted by Continental Oil Company to the USGS to drill the G6 well as a sidetrack out of the G3 wellbore on March 10, 1969. The subsequent spud date for the G06 well was 03/26/1969 with a TD date of 04/08/1969.  Completed operations on the G Platform included the successful plug and abandonment of the G6 well.

Due to proximity of hurricane season and anticipated duration of work, the previously communicated request to recomplete in the MM-7 zone will be deferred until a later date. The completion of the MM5/6
and LL-25 will be set up such that the MM-7 can be captured thru-tubing in the future.

Completed as an intelligent completion (IWC) with two frac packs in the 12,800 ft. and 12,600 ft. sands. The 3-1/2 inch production tubing assembly includes smart valves (2 direct, hydraulically operated sliding sleeves), one CID (chemical injection mandrel down
hole), DHPT (down hole pressure/temperature gauges), and deep set SCSSV. An FMC horizontal tree (HXT) will be installed during this completion.

Suspend Wellbore

1. Make up and run the 22? surface casing.

2. Circulate & condition mud. Rig up and test cementing lines. Cement the casing as per program -->Pump minimum 4082 ft^3 16.0 ppg class H cement (nitrogen-foamed lead slurry); displace TOC to surface and leave minimum of 100' above float shoe. Check to confirm floats are holding.

3. Close the annulus valves. Release running tool and displace 22" casing to 12.5 ppg WBM.  Pull out of the hole with the running tool and inner string.

4. Install TA cap with ROV.

Badger has performed the initial step of the change zone procedure (step 1) isolating the Lentic Sand with a TTBP, which currently leaves the well in TA status; however, upon rig arrival, the recompletion operation to the AB-10 and AB-12 Sands will resume.  An RPM will be submitted to reopen the change zone WAR.

Stone has ended operations on the PL22 B001 ST02 BP01 to clean-out tubing with CT Unit.  The operation was unsuccessfully completed and consequently suspended early due to tubing parting.  Operations began 10/08/2012 and ended 10/18/2012.

Operations to recover the 10-3/4" x 16" x 24" casings to conclude permanent abandonment of the well were completed on 07/12/2023.

*NOTE - eWell previously listed the date of PA as of 11/01/1978 and does not allow the date to change without a status change, therefore, the PA date remains listed as 11/01/1972.

ERT has successful completed the drilling and completion operations fo the SS 224 E20BP well.  The well was spud on 09-24-08 at a depth of 5802' and drilled to TD on 10-12-08 to a depth of 13096' MD / 11590' TVD.  Completion operations were completed on 11-04-08, with the rig released from locaton on 11-09-08. The well was completed as a single, gravel packed oil completion in the "EP Upper" Sand with exisiting perforations of 12752' - 12790' MD.

Stone Energy has successfully plug and abandoned the OCS 00079, Well No. 006/006D due to caisson being damage from a boating accident.  Operations began on October 1, 2007 and were completed on October 12, 2007.

Zone change operations on ST 34, OCS-G-04842, Well A-2ST1 have been suspended.  Operations began on February 11, 2010 and ended on February 26, 2010.  The previous completion interval, the "R-3" Sand was successfully isolated by setting a TTVBP @ 12405' MD & dumping cmt on top of the plug, ETOC @ 12356' MD.  It was then discovered that the production pkr @ 12207' MD is leaking and operations were suspended.  Note: There is no sustained csg pressure on the well.  An APM to address the leaking pkr @ 12207' MD and complete zone change operation to expose the "R-1" Sand to production, proposed perfs 12332' - 12350' MD, will be filed at a later date.  Per EOR database requirements, the well status has been noted as temporarily abandoned.

The B1 Sand was addressed on the wellbore diagram. (Please see attached)
The B1 Sand is not listed in the completion list in Ewell.

The casings are protected by the four pile structure. The casings will be removed when the structure is removed.

Stone has successfully performed zone change operations on the PL 23 OCS G-01238, Well No. E002ST1 to produce the 11200' Sd.  Operations began on March 1, 2008 and were completed on March 5, 2008.  The previous producing interval in the well, the "Z-1" Sd. was isolated by setting a posi-set plug @ 13440' and dumping 38' cmt on top, ETOC @ 13402'.  The 11200' Sd. was perforated @ 11418' - 11428' to production.

Stone has successfully completed plugback operations on the MC 28 Well A-19. An inflatable cement retainer was set at 7147' MD in the 9-5/8" casing. Cement was displaced and squeezed below the retainer with ETOC at 12650' MD. Cement was squeezed below the retainer at 7147' MD and cement dumped on top of the retainer w/ TOC at 6969' MD. Cement plug at 6969' MD was pressure tested to 1000 psi. Operations began 06-07-12 and ended 07-17-12.

30" DP was cut 17' BML on 3/9/2011.  20" csg was cut 17' BML on 3/8/2011.  Stone Energy was unable to pull the 30" DP x 20" csg at this time.  They will be pulled when the associated EI243 D-AUX structure is removed.  13-3/8" casing cut 18' BML on 3/8/2011.
